candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108) (c. 100 BC)

'And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten and brothers shall fall in death together' — the horror of intra-family slaughter as eschatological marker. Tewahedo homiletic tradition uses 100:1 with 99:5 as paired witnesses to the same eschatological scenario, citing them together when interpreting the Synoptic apocalypse-discourses.

candidates.draft_body:

'And in those days the angels shall descend into the secret places and gather together into one place all those who brought down sin, and the Most High will arise on that day of judgement to execute great judgement amongst sinners' — angelic descent for the gathering-of-sinners. candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108) (c. 100 BC)

'Woe to you, sinners, on the day of strong anguish, ye who afflict the righteous and burn them with fire: ye shall be requited according to your works' — woe oracle for those who burn the righteous (allusion to martyrdom).
